title: 24" Dishwasher with Third Level Utensil Rack
sub: PrintShield stainless, bar handle, top controls
lead: KitchenAid at 47 dBA, with more than 30 wash jets on three wash arms, a third rack for utensils and heated drying that opens the door when the cycle ends. PrintShield stainless keeps fingerprints off the front.

features.name: Third level utensil rack
features.line: A shallow rack across the top for spatulas, ladles and serving pieces, so they stop crowding the basket. Water Repellent Tech helps it shed droplets before you unload.

features.name: 30+ wash jets on three arms
features.line: More than thirty jets on three wash arms reach every rack, the third included.

features.name: ProDry with door-open drying
features.line: A heating element warms the air to dry the load, then the door opens on its own to let the steam out. ProDry Max adds time when a load needs more.

features.name: Quiet at 47 dBA
features.line: Rated at 47 dBA, quiet enough to run with the kitchen still in use.

features.name: ProWash
features.line: A sensor reads how dirty the load is and sets the wash time and water temperature to match.

also: Express Wash for a quicker turnaround
Versatile lower rack for pots and odd shapes
Leak Identification System, which watches for most leaks under the tub
